16/G.goal: Explain the foundational model of tracking in XR systems, including its scope, tracker-placement methods, and process stages.
16/G.achieves: Provides the conceptual foundation for understanding XR hardware and software and for approaching the design and implementation of tracking in XR systems with confidence.

16/O1.goal: Explain the scope of tracking in XR systems, from why it is needed to the main categories of tracked entities.
16/O1.achieves: Gives the learner the shared terminology and conceptual distinctions needed to discuss VR and AR tracking requirements and user interaction with virtual or mixed content.

16/O2.goal: Describe the structure of tracking in XR systems, from tracker placement to the main stages that turn sensor measurements into a tracked pose.
16/O2.achieves: Enables the learner to understand how tracking hardware and software work and to reason about pose-related requirements in later XR system design and implementation.
